paper.title: Randomized placebo-controlled trial of medium-chain triglycerides in mild cognitive impairment
paper.summary: In a double-blind randomized placebo-controlled trial, adults with mild cognitive impairment received medium-chain triglycerides or placebo for 24 weeks. The intervention group showed significant improvement in memory composite scores with acceptable gastrointestinal safety and adherence.

paper.title: Pilot ketone ester supplementation improves cognitive task performance in patients with mild cognitive impairment
paper.summary: This pilot clinical study enrolled patients diagnosed with mild cognitive impairment and evaluated ketone ester supplementation for 12 weeks. Investigators report improved executive-function task scores, preserved activities of daily living, and no major safety concerns.

paper.title: Optimizing tamoxifen induction and recombination efficiency in inducible Cre-loxP mouse models
paper.summary: This methods-focused study benchmarks tamoxifen dosing, washout windows, and recombination-efficiency readouts for inducible Cre-loxP neuroscience experiments. The paper provides actionable protocol guidance and troubleshooting steps for minimizing off-target recombination.

paper.title: Clinical practice guideline for liquid biopsy biomarkers in metastatic colorectal cancer
paper.summary: This consensus guideline provides authoritative recommendations for diagnosis, treatment monitoring, and biomarker interpretation in metastatic colorectal cancer using circulating tumor DNA and plasma biomarkers.

paper.title: Standardizing flow cytometry assay validation for monitoring CAR-T cell persistence in lymphoma patients
paper.summary: This translational methods paper validates a flow cytometry assay, benchmark controls, and protocol optimization workflow for monitoring CAR-T cell persistence in patients with lymphoma.

paper.title: Pilot translational study of a hydrogel wound dressing in diabetic foot ulcers
paper.summary: In this pilot translational clinical study, patients with diabetic foot ulcers received a hydrogel wound dressing with standard care comparison. The intervention improved wound closure and tissue repair markers with acceptable safety.

paper.title: Ketogenic diet improves endurance performance in collegiate cyclists
paper.summary: Healthy trained cyclists followed a ketogenic diet and completed endurance testing. Performance and body-composition outcomes improved, but the study did not involve neurological disease, cognition, or neuroscience methods.

paper.title: Ceramide-inspired self-assembly improves membrane stability in synthetic polymer films
paper.summary: This materials-science paper studies synthetic polymer films and uses ceramide-inspired chemistry to improve membrane stability. The work is not about brain disease, neuroinflammation, cognition, or biomedical methods relevant to PaperPipe.

paper.title: Review of hydrogel scaffolds for regenerative medicine and wound healing
paper.summary: This broad review surveys hydrogel scaffolds, regenerative biomaterials, and wound-healing applications across preclinical and translational settings. It does not present new clinical data or authoritative biomedical guidance.

paper.title: Narrative review of dietary interventions across aging, dementia, and general wellness populations
paper.summary: This narrative review broadly discusses dietary interventions across healthy aging, Alzheimer's disease, and general wellness populations. It does not present MCI-specific evidence, new data, or a clear high-significance finding that warrants automatic approval.
